crawler_requirements: Start from TIL game/category/search/index pages and transcript seeds.
Extract internal TIL links and score transcript likelihood from title, headings and page structure.
Classify before fetching into the dialogue corpus.
Persist frontier, visited URLs, classification and failure reason.
Respect rate limits and cache raw HTML locally.
Deduplicate canonical URLs and content hashes.
Continue breadth-first across games rather than recursively exhausting one quest chain.
Emit normalized transcript records compatible with dialogue-record.schema.json.
validation_plan: Use Horn of Jurgen Windcaller only as parser fixture.
Sample at least one transcript from each game corpus discovered.
Measure speaker attribution accuracy, prompt-response pairing accuracy and false dialogue classification rate.
Only then run bulk local ingestion.
